context: Identical intent, situation, available_tools for both methods; identical usefulness question text and IDs. Only readiness questions and gate differ.
selection_order: highest combined correct recommendations on development
smallest squared distance from initial cutoffs
shared_gate: Both methods use the same selected usefulness cutoff. Only the two-score method uses readiness cutoff.
order: Alternate strategy order by case index; retain tool order; one run per method/case; fail fast, no automatic retries.
held_out_rule: Commit cutoff-selection.json before invoking held-out phase; no held-out retuning.
numerical_labels: Without a supplied comparison, accept the better direct choice or free calculation. With a supplied verified comparison, accept only the better direct choice. Raw cases do not explicitly require calculation.
readiness_labels: Diagnostic operational availability under stated inputs and constraints, independent of usefulness. The unchanged v1 prompt also mentions justification, so label mismatch remains a possible explanation.
budget: 32 successful model requests, 16 development and 16 held-out; no execution or state mutation.
